name: Keen Eyes
body:
School: transmutation; Level: alchemist 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 minute/level

DESCRIPTION

This spell grants a competence bonus on Perception checks equal to 1/3 caster level (maximum +5). If you possess the ability to detect hidden doors automatically, such as if you are an elf, the range of this sense increases by 10 feet.
